blocks.x: Extraction and adjudication inside the process, not beside it: documents become decisions with confidence gates, per-field evidence and a human queue that shrinks by design — because the root causes of the queue are fixed, not just staffed.
The queue is the product: what it says about your operation

IDP inside hyperautomation is different from standalone extraction: the output is not a spreadsheet, it is a process decision — an invoice matched, a claim registered, a contract clause routed. That means confidence gates tuned per field class, adjudication queues that feed the process, and evidence that satisfies the audit two years later.

The measure of success is the human queue, and it must shrink on measurement: straight-through rate climbs as the adjudicated eval set grows, and every correction a reviewer makes becomes training signal under version control.
Below: the failure modes that keep document queues eternal, the architecture that wires adjudication into the process, and the console that shows the queue shrinking by root cause.
Four failure modes that keep document queues eternal
Each of these survives a pilot and bankrupts the operation at scale — the countermeasures target root causes so the queue shrinks instead of being staffed.

blocks.x: Reference architecture — adjudication wired into the process

Confidence gates route fields, not documents: high-confidence fields post, low-confidence fields route to an adjudication surface whose verdicts feed the extractor — so every human minute makes the next hundred documents cheaper.

widgets.title: Document path — click each stage for its contract

stages.name: Ingest
stages.detail: Mail, portal uploads, EDI and scans land with provenance stamped; channel metadata drives preprocessing (deskew, DPI normalization) before any model sees pixels.

stages.name: Classify
stages.detail: Document family first, then layout-registry match; unknown layouts quarantine with a low-cost strategy while the registry learns.

stages.name: Extract
stages.detail: Field-level extraction with confidence calibrated per field class; totals get arithmetic cross-checks (line items must sum) before acceptance logic.

stages.name: Verify
stages.detail: Vendor master match, PO match, arithmetic identity, duplicate detection — the checks that catch what confidence cannot see.

stages.name: Review
stages.detail: Uncertain fields routed with highlights and candidates; corrections typed back with provenance and flow into the next training round.

stages.name: Write
stages.detail: SAP/ERP postings carry idempotency keys and reconciliation totals; a replayed batch corrects rather than duplicates.

widgets.note: Verification catches about 3% of documents that confidence alone would have waved through — arithmetic does not hallucinate.
